text:
Maya: quick async check — rolling train status before handoff. what did you finish, any blockers, and any cherry-pick asks?
Sam: landed the retry fix on routing, canary looks stable. one cherry-pick (#4521) is blocked by a flaky e2e.
Priya: I'm debugging the e2e failure, looks like a race on container shutdown. reproducing locally now.
Alex: FYI I swapped the quota config for the dedicated lane, will monitor token spikes for the next 30m. no cherrypicks from infra. :eyes: 
Jia: re: cherry #4521 — test failure trace points to `kv_cache::flush()` timing. I'll add a small sleep in the test to see if it passes, will follow-up with a patch.
Sam: thanks @Jia. if you push a fix ping me and I'll re-run the canary. currently traffic is 85% baseline, latency +2ms.
Maya: tagging @release-bot — can we get a deploy health snapshot for us-west-2 and eu-central?
release-bot: deploy report — us-west-2: stable, 3 warning traces (GC spikes), avg p50 18ms; eu-central: one abort, automatically rolled back, investigating. <https://internal.metrics/redwood/deploy/3965>
Priya: found a flaky mock in test harness where the shutdown hook races with network teardown. pushing a small mock fix (PR #4530).
Alex: noted. I'll hold off on manual quota changes until PR merges.
Sam: PR #4530 LGTM, re-ran CI, tests passed. unblocking cherry-pick #4521.
Jia: re-cherry-picked and queued for canary. command i used:
```
git fetch origin && git checkout -b cherry-4521 origin/main && git cherry-pick 1a2b3c4
```
Sam: canary accepted the cherrypick, no new regressions after 20m. rolling to remaining pools in 5m. :thumbsup:
Maya: sweet. blockers cleared? any other asks before I close the train for today?
Priya: no blockers on my side, will follow up on post-deploy monitoring if anything pops.
Alex: ping me if quota noise shows up, I can roll a tweak quickly.
Jia: I'll watch the KV metrics for the next hour.
Maya: thanks all — closing this thread in ~15m unless someone raises anything new. :sparkles:
